text.p: The Trace Overview shows details of the recorded trace as well as any warnings produced by the recorder.

To allow loading traces with lots of warnings, like a trace where the communication was not fast enough for all data to come through, the main tree view (left side) will only show all warnings if they are few enough. If all are not show, select the Warnings from Recorder node, and the list (right side) will show all warnings.

To allow information to efficiently be copied from the trace overview to the clipboard, to use in other programs, the Selection menu can be used.
Options here can show Selection Mode, which sets a check box on each tree node to allow only selecting a subset of the nodes, and to select if the copy should be done as a tree (i.e. tabbed), or as a flat list.
Copy Selected Nodes will copy the single selected node if not in Selection Mode (with check boxes).
Copy All Nodes will not include items that are not in the tree, e.g. if there are too many warnings.
